coverage: Full-tree static inventory and compiled native-API audit, with targeted source review and independent runtime scenarios. This is not a claim that every line was manually read.
reviewedAreas: item use, selected hand, energy, durability, repair and rarity
transactional transfers and sided vanilla inventories
server/client ownership, GUI fields, chunk ordering and tile reconstruction
crop placement, growth, environmental state, ground and biome edits
recipe matching, remainders, crafting-book placement and processing
reactor, upgrade and energy-network state transitions
native item, fluid, equipment and wall models
localization retention, formats, archive boundaries and project identity
Per-slot IC2 component capacities, exact transaction rollback, and full-slot routing across three actual machines
remainingApiLimitation: Raw Enchantment objects in the old DataEncoder enum are unsupported by the original custom protocol port. Current ItemStack enchantment components use the native stack codec and do not call those legacy branches.
dataGeneratorDisposition: The existing Gradle main source set explicitly excludes ic2/data/**. These legacy generator sources are inventoried but not compiled or shipped; current migrated resources and Python migration tools provide the port data.
